
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- multi_every.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNREACHABLE -- multi_every.volt:11[/yellow bold]

Code after `every`/`on` block in task `blinker` will never execute.

 [dim]10 |[/dim]     }
 [dim]11 |[/dim]     every 100ms {
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]          ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Move this code before the `every` block, or into a separate task.[/cyan]
